laws.rule: Increased security measures apply across Xinjiang: carry photo ID and expect airport-style checks of passports, bags and phones. Photographing sensitive sites, or engaging with ethnic minority groups or charities, draws attention from authorities. Xinjiang is not a 240-hour visa-free transit area.
